result:
Got it — the cron job runs under a different user account, so it can't access your shell profile. The CLI needs to be in a system-wide PATH location that all accounts can see.

On Windows, common system-wide PATH locations are:
- `C:\Windows\System32` (for any executable)
- `C:\Program Files` (for installed tools)
- Or any directory already in the system `PATH` environment variable

On Linux/macOS, it would be:
- `/usr/local/bin`
- `/usr/bin`
- Or another directory in the system PATH

What CLI are you setting up, and which OS is the cron job running on? I can help you get it in the right location.
